info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Design Update API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Design Update API allows marketing teams to modify existing customer campaign designs within the banking sector. This endpoint facilitates the adjustment of campaign parameters to better target potential customers and enhance engagement. Typical consumers of this API include marketing professionals looking to refine their campaign strategies or product managers aiming to align campaign messaging with current business goals. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure their campaigns are both effective and aligned with their evolving marketing objectives.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the design of a specific customer campaign identified by its unique identifier. You can modify various aspects of the campaign design according to your requirements.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of the customer campaign design specified by CUST-100045. Ensure that all required fields are provided to successfully update the campaign.
